thread:
Sasha Lin: Heads-up: MerchantX flagged their Aug 17 invoice. They claim ~3,312 embeds and ~94.2K tokens from 18:30-18:50 UTC are missing. Ledger undercount vs canonical. Can infra confirm whether these were dropped or simply unmetered?

BillingBot: [alert] meter-forwarder eu-central publish_failures 2026-08-17T18:35:12Z -> kafka publish retried; last error: BrokerUnavailable. Topic: billing-acks.

Omar Patel: Quick check - canonical shows 23,412 embed rows and 1,234,512 tokens in that 20-min window for MerchantX. Ledger shows 20,100 embeds and 1,140,312 tokens. Delta: 3,312 embeds and 94,200 tokens. Exported minute-level counts to s3://redwood-finance/reconciliations/2026-08-17/merchantx-1830-counts.csv

Jun Park: Early signal: client SDK v2.3.1 had an exponential retry bug that regenerated request_id on retry leading to missing idempotency keys for ~3,300 requests. Those requests were processed by the model server and stored, but billing-acks used request_id as dedupe key, so the forwarded acks were seen as distinct or dropped depending on the forwarder state.

Priya Patel: So data landed but ack messages either weren't published or had mismatched idempotency keys. We have options: (1) replay ack events with corrected idempotency keys, (2) run a ledger recount that reconciles canonical->ledger mapping and adjust invoice, (3) issue one-off credit. Which gives best audit trail?

Jun Park: Replay is preferred. We can rebuild ack events using the canonical event ids and reconstructed request_ids from ingress logs. Work: ~2.5 hours including validation. We'll emit manifest with per-event checksum and an overall sha256. Risk: must temporarily allow backfill mode for MerchantX to accept corrected keys.

BillingBot: [info] ticket FIN-9221 opened: "MerchantX sdk-retry request_id regen -> backfill" assigned to @Jun Park.

Sasha Lin: Finance: provisional delta estimation? Use embed price $0.11/embed + token unit price $0.00008/token.

Priya Patel: Quick calc: embeds: 3,312 * $0.11 = $364.32. Tokens: 94,200 * $0.00008 = $7.536. Total provisional delta ~$371.86. We'll wait for manifest before applying.

Jun Park: Starting reconstruction + replay now (job rp-euc-merchantx-20260817). Will upload manifest to s3://redwood-telemetry/replays/rp-euc-merchantx-20260817/manifest.json when complete. Manifest will include: job_id, rows_replayed, tokens_reconciled, per_event_sha list, overall_sha256.

LegalBot: Reminder: include a brief non-technical customer note and have legal review before sending.

Jun Park: Replay finished 2026-08-17T21:02:12Z. Written 3,312 ack events. Manifest link: s3://redwood-telemetry/replays/rp-euc-merchantx-20260817/manifest.json SHA256: 4a8f2b7c9d1e3f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9. Payload: rows_replayed=3312, tokens_reconciled=94200.

Omar Patel: Post-replay recount shows ledger now matches canonical for that window. Uploaded recount CSV to s3://redwood-finance/reconciliations/2026-08-17/merchantx-recount-1830.csv. Noted 7 events flagged as "merge-risk" due to tokenization newline anomalies.

Priya Patel: Finance: applying adjustment $371.86 and attaching replay manifest SHA to billing notes. Will queue invoice correction before the next billing run.

Sasha Lin: Please prepare a short customer message for MerchantX: "We identified a transient SDK retry issue that caused some usage not to be recorded on your invoice for Aug 17 (18:30-18:50 UTC). We've reconciled the events and adjusted your invoice by $371.86. Manifest and reconciliation details are attached. No action required." We'll send to #customer-communication for legal signoff.

BillingBot: [info] FIN-9221 status -> awaiting customer ack.

Jun Park: Uploaded manifest and per-event checksums. All checksums verified. Closing replay job.

Priya Patel: Adjustment applied and billing note attached. Closing FIN-9221 after MerchantX confirms. :white_check_mark:
